mysteries.name: The Annunciation
mysteries.meditation: He came to her and said, 'Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you'.

mysteries.name: The Visitation
mysteries.meditation: When Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, the child leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit and she exclaimed with a loud cry, 'Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!'

mysteries.name: The Nativity
mysteries.meditation: Mary 'gave birth to her first-born son and wrapped him in swaddling clothes and laid him in a manger'.

mysteries.name: The Presentation
mysteries.meditation: When the time came for their purification according to the law of Moses, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord.

mysteries.name: The Finding in the Temple
mysteries.meditation: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions; and all who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

mysteries.name: The Agony in the Garden
mysteries.meditation: Watch and pray that you may not enter into temptation; the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

mysteries.name: The Scourging at the Pillar
mysteries.meditation: Pilot said 'I am innocent of this man's blood'... and having scourged Jesus, delivered him to be crucified.

mysteries.name: The Crowning with Thorns
mysteries.meditation: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe upon him, and plaiting a crown of thorns, they put it on his head, and put a reed in his right hand.

mysteries.name: The Carrying of the Cross
mysteries.meditation: So they took Jesus, and he went out, bearing his own cross, to the place called the place of the skull.

mysteries.name: The Crucifixion
mysteries.meditation: But standing by the cross of Jesus were his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

mysteries.name: The Resurrection
mysteries.meditation: Entering the tomb, they saw a young man and they were amazed. He said to them, 'Do not be amazed; you seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He has risen, he is not here.

mysteries.name: The Ascension
mysteries.meditation: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken to them, was taken up into heaven and he sat at the right hand of God.

mysteries.name: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
mysteries.meditation: There appeared to them tongues as of fire, distributed and resting on each of them.

mysteries.name: The Assumption
mysteries.meditation: My beloved speaks... to me: Arise my love, my dove, my fair one,  and come away for behold the winter is past, the rain is over and gone.

mysteries.name: The Coronation of Mary
mysteries.meditation: A great sign appeared in heaven, a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of 12 stars.

mysteries.name: The Baptism of Jesus
mysteries.meditation: When Jesus was baptized, he went up immediately from the water, and behold, the heavens were opened and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and behold, a voice from heaven saying 'This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.'

mysteries.name: The Wedding Feast at Cana
mysteries.meditation: His mother said to the servants, 'Do whatever he tells you.'

mysteries.name: The Preaching of the Kingdom
mysteries.meditation: The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand; repent, and believe in the gospel.

mysteries.name: The Transfiguration
mysteries.meditation: Jesus is transfigured before His disciples, and his face shown like the son, and his garments became white as light.

mysteries.name: The Institution of the Eucharist
mysteries.meditation: [Jesus] took the bread, and blessed, and broke it, and gave it to them, and said, 'Take; this is my body.' [Jesus] took a chalice, and when he had given thanks he gave it to them, and they drank of it.
